Animal Crossing - Happy Home Designer.name: Animal Crossing: Happy Home Designer
Animal Crossing - Happy Home Designer.summary: Show off your style by designing homes for all of your favorite Animal Crossing villagers! Use your creativity to design the perfect houses—inside and out—for both old and new friends. With the new amiibo cards, you can call your favorite villagers into the game.
developers: Nintendo EAD Software Development Group No.2

Cardfight!! Vanguard - Lock On Victory!!.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Lock on Victory!!
Cardfight!! Vanguard - Lock On Victory!!.summary: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Lock on Victory!! is the second Cardfight!! Vanguard video game to be released on the Nintendo 3DS.

LEGO Harry Potter - Years 5-7.name: LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7
LEGO Harry Potter - Years 5-7.summary: Based on the last three Harry Potter books and final four films, LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7 takes players through Harry Potter’s heroic adventures in the Muggle and wizarding worlds. From Privet Drive in Little Whinging to Diagon Alley, Hogsmeade and Hogwarts – plus new locations including Grimmauld Place, the Ministry of Magic, and Godric’s Hollow – players will encounter new faces, new challenges and new magic, preparing them for the ultimate face-off against Lord Voldemort.

Mario & Luigi - Bowser's Inside Story +.name: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey
Mario & Luigi - Bowser's Inside Story +.summary: In addition to the game’s revamped graphics and refined gameplay, a new side story follows Bowser Jr. as he gathers an army, creates formations, supports his allies with an arsenal of moves and generally causes chaos (in the best way possible).
